variation.scope: Height and tie reduction, upper lifts

deciding.design_conformity: Height 24.4 against 24 and ties 13 against 17 are both departures, and variation V-9 covers height and tie reduction, though its scope says only 'upper lifts', which leaves slight doubt.
deciding.handover_decision: Scaffold drawing_ref D-31/C differs from design D-31/D. That is a single outstanding confirmation (corrected reference); tie test passed and no defects.
deciding.limiting_issue: There is no defect and the departures sit within a variation, which favours none_found; the vague variation scope keeps design_departure defensible.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Ties 13 against 17 is 23.5% short, just under the 25% anchor, so level 2 leads and level 3 stays plausible.
deciding.releasable_share: Under the drawing reference mismatch the handover is held and no lift is released until the reference is corrected.
